parsing_res_list.block_content: Depending upon the magnitude of these rebound forces, the required compression reinforcement may equal the tension reinforcement.

The critical section is taken at a distance, d, from the face of the support for those members that cause compression in their supports. The shear at sections between the face of the support and a distance, d, from the support therefore need not be considered critical. For those members that cause tension in their supports, the critical section is at the face of the supports.
The shear stress permitted on an unreinforced web of a beam subjected to flexure only may be calculated by either Equation 4-140a or 4-140b.
